scope_note: M1a is LANDED (commit 8ee07ef23, amended d545d4a9e) — enforcement + Anthropic per-role pinning, driver-side verified live 2026-07-16 06:23. This sprint covers the REMAINING milestones only: M1b (codex cross-provider executor via Gate 3), M2 (right-sizing table + evidence schema), M3 (planner down-tier A/B, PARKED with a concrete protocol).
hard_constraints: Deployment reality: launchd reads the ON-DISK main checkout; skill/driver/charter edits merged only to a PR branch do NOT reach the loop until the main checkout is git-pull --ff-only synced. Never reset/checkout over uncommitted work (Critical Principle 0).
No new Go plumbing: reuse internal/coordinator/provider_executor.go + the codex executor. M1b is skill-orchestration, not a coordinator code change.
Generator != judge: evaluator provider MUST differ from executor provider.
Every wait bounded <=30 min; GPU (ollama/motoko/rig.lock) steps are OUT of scope.
Sprint-sized <=2 days for the executable slice; M3 is parked as a protocol, not forced inline.
codex smoke must be token-cheap: trivial probe (reply with exactly: ok) + DryRun path, not a full real coding run.

velocity.sizing_note: Skill/driver/charter TEXT + a token-cheap probe path, not feature LOC. 7-day repo velocity is data/eval-rotation churn and not a meaningful signal here. Sized by task shape.

features.description: mission-control Gate 3 branches a provider:model env value (e.g. MISSION_EXECUTOR_MODEL=codex:gpt-5.6-sol) to a bounded codex exec run against the sprint worktree, instead of the in-session Agent tool. Reuses provider_executor.go + the codex executor (no Go plumbing). codex is the preferred provider (CLI installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/codex, OPENAI_API_KEY set; motoko needs the GPU rig.lock and is out of scope).

acceptance_criteria: Gate 3 in the ON-DISK SKILL has a concrete provider:model -> codex exec spawn recipe with a bounded (<=30 min, date +%s deadline) cap.
A codex exec trivial probe succeeds token-cheaply (reply with exactly: ok) proving auth+model+CLI before any real directive.
generator != judge asserted in-recipe: evaluator provider != executor provider (re-route to distinct provider + FLAG on collision).
Fallback-to-$MODEL-via-Agent-tool-and-FLAG on codex failure documented (never wedge the loop).
One iteration (or dry harness run) demonstrates controller (claude) and executor (codex) on DIFFERENT PROVIDERS; Gate-4 row records provider=codex agent=codex model=<gpt-5.x>.
Change deployed to the main checkout (grep-verified on disk via git pull --ff-only), not merely merged to a PR branch.
features.notes: Recipe landed in .claude/skills/mission-control/SKILL.md (after the provider:model concept line): env parse ^([a-z_]+):(.+)$, codex branch with token-cheap pre-flight probe + bounded 30-min date+%s deadline codex exec in the sprint worktree, worktree-branch/diff read reusing the claude path, generator!=judge assert (re-route+FLAG on collision), fallback-to-$MODEL-via-Agent+FLAG on any codex failure. Driver comment at mission-control.sh:186 documents MISSION_EXECUTOR_MODEL accepts alias OR provider:model, default stays opus (codex opt-in). LIVE PROBE VERIFIED 2026-07-16: `codex exec --model gpt-5.6-sol 'reply with exactly: ok'` -> exit 0, replied 'ok', ~13.7k tokens, codex-cli 0.137.0. No model substitution needed (gpt-5.6-sol valid, models.yml:201 agent_cli codex). Worked directly on dev in the main checkout (controller-authorized deviation: launchd reads on-disk checkout). NOT-YET-VERIFIED: a full real cross-provider iteration end-to-end (recipe is executable but the acceptance uses the token-cheap probe per constraint #6).
